package: Slay the Math - Focus Card Balance
user_confirmed_scope: Focus tersedia untuk Attack, Defend dan Skill
Peningkatan perlu sederhana dan mudah difahami

source_snapshot.important: Runtime config currently contains 12 card definitions with older names. The approved 40-icon set is a design selection, not proof that these 40 card mechanics exist in runtime. Older SOR numeric examples are superseded by inspected config for runtime facts.

rules.hybrid_card_policy: Enhance one primary effect only: Attack damage, Defend Block, Skill its explicitly listed effect.
rules.damage_timing: Compute ordinary upgraded/stat-modified attack, then add flat Focus bonus once, then apply ordinary mitigation.
rules.block_timing: Compute ordinary upgraded/stat-modified Block, then add flat Focus bonus once.
rules.no_effect_policy: If preview proves the Focus-specific bonus cannot produce any benefit (such as no capacity beyond base draw), show ordinary effect and preserve the Focus stock and armed state. A legal random/search attempt may still fail after commit; that is not refunded.

numeric_example_status: Quick Study 2, Deep Study 4, Read Ahead 3 and Next Chapter 2 continue the supplied design examples. Clear Choice group size 3 and Last Page D=1/E=2 are explicit proposed defaults. Damage/Block bases are not invented for the 40-card designs. Energy, rarity and unprovided side effects require their own authoritative definitions.
